description: A long passage containing exactly one clearly independent, quotable sentence surrounded by scene-setting.
sourceText: It was late in the afternoon when the committee finally reconvened after their long recess, and most of the members were visibly tired from the earlier debate. Papers were shuffled, coffee was poured, and someone opened a window to let in some air. The chairman cleared his throat and reminded everyone of the agenda item still pending from the morning session. Then, almost as an aside, he said: the only real failure is the refusal to try again. After that, the meeting returned to its usual procedural rhythm, with motions, seconds, and the occasional interruption from the back row.
